name: renames are not looked for
catches: keeps every file two revisions differ in, both whole sides, and git's ranges, under a random id

name: untracked files are left out of a working-tree capture
catches: takes the working tree as the new side, its uncommitted changes and new untracked files included

name: no path in a capture is checked against the deny list
catches: never keeps a file the view never shows, by any side, and lists it by its name

name: a revision that starts with - reaches git as an option
catches: refuses a revision that starts with -, and one git does not know, before anything is written

name: any directory counts as inside the instance
catches: refuses a repository outside the instance, by its path or by a link to it

edits.from: const inside = (where) => where === top || where.startsWith(top + path.sep);

name: a capture is kept for ever
catches: is gone once it is older than it is kept, and dropped by the next capture

name: a span a line break cut is not opened again on the next line
catches: cuts a whole side's highlighting into lines, reopening a span a line break cut

name: a range with no old lines is read as starting at its old start
catches: pairs the lines both sides share and the changes between them, from git's ranges

name: a fold hides a single line
catches: folds an unchanged run past three lines beside each change, and none that would hide one line

name: an added line has no filler beside it
catches: draws a file side by side and unified, numbered on both sides, a filler beside an added line, folds hidden

name: a file's body is fetched from the file before it
catches: draws the page with the list of files and each file's head, its body left to be fetched
